market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Iran war escalation, oil surge, and multi-decade-high bond yields create headwinds. September seasonal weakness amplified by geopolitics. Earnings (Palo Alto, Salesforce, Marvell) provide partial support but cannot offset macro shock. Expect 3-5% equity drawdown risk into month-end. Crypto remains vulnerable. Watch Brent crude $100 and 10Y yield 5% as key triggers.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex super-cycle (PwC $31.6T through 2050, Brookfield $25B, Microsoft-Chevron 20-year deal) provides structural growth. Power/infrastructure is the next multi-year theme. China tech profit growth and EM diversification offer alpha. Key risk: if AI capex decelerates or power constraints cap deployment, multiple compression follows. Inflation trajectory is the swing factor.
